slides.title: What is Industrial AI?
slides.subtitle: Applying AI to Address Industrial Pain-Points
paragraphs: Industrial artificial intelligence refers to the application of AI to industrial business processes.
It focuses on addressing pain-points for customer value creation, productivity improvement, cost reduction, site optimization, predictive analysis, and insight discovery.
bullets: Solid-state cells: higher energy density with lower fire risk
Predictive maintenance: reducing downtime and increasing efficiency
Automated quality control: improving product consistency

slides.subtitle: Advancements in Sensors, Computation, and Connectivity

bullets: Sensor advancements: enabling real-time monitoring and feedback
Cloud services: outsourcing data management and computing power

slides.title: Conclusion
slides.subtitle: Unlocking Industry Potential with AI
bullets: Industrial AI is transforming business processes and operations across industries.
Key enablers include advancements in sensors, computation, and connectivity.
AI adoption rates are increasing across sectors, driven by innovation and demand.

slides.title: Slide 7
bullets: AI is revolutionizing industries worldwide, transforming business models and operations.
Key takeaways include the growing demand for AI talent and skills, as well as the need for responsible AI development and deployment.

slides.title: Slide 8
bullets: Industrial AI is a key driver of innovation and growth across industries.
Its adoption rates are increasing, driven by the need for productivity improvement, cost reduction, and site optimization.

slides.title: Slide 9
bullets: The future of AI in industry is bright, with increasing adoption rates and innovative applications across sectors.
However, it also raises important questions about ethics and governance, ensuring responsible AI development and deployment.
